name: self-nesting-depth
body: Self-nesting depth, worked. One template `T` declares a `loop` section that accepts `T` with `max_depth: 1`, and a slide nests `# events` (T) › `## loop` (T) › `### loop` (T). Every instance resolves template `T`, and each instance's `.item.depth` is the count of enclosing instances whose resolved template is also `T`: the `events` instance has no `T` ancestor, so `.item.depth` is 0; the first `loop` sits under the `events` `T` instance, so `.item.depth` is 1; the second `loop` sits under two `T` instances, so `.item.depth` is 2. With `max_depth: 1` the bound is `.item.depth` at most 1, so the depth-0 and depth-1 instances are accepted and the depth-2 instance is reported `section "loop": nesting deeper than max_depth 1`. `.item.section` names the declared slot at each level — `events` for the depth-0 instance and `loop` for each nested instance — and `.item.parent` is the immediately enclosing instance's field values at every level.
